data.content:
Our team looks at away form over the last 5, 10, and 20 games, the home side's recent record on their own ground, head-to-head history in that specific venue, injury and suspension reports, squad depth comparisons, and live market movement. We only publish an away win tip when all of those signals are pointing in the same direction. If the data is mixed, we pass on the fixture and look elsewhere. That discipline is a big part of why our accuracy rate stays consistently high. [...] Away form is also one of the most telling indicators of a genuinely strong squad. Teams that travel well tend to be well-organised, well-coached, and mentally resilient. When you see a side with 7 or 8 wins from 10 away games, that is not luck. That is a team that has built a system capable of performing in hostile environments week after week. Those are exactly the sides our analysts love to back away from home, and those are the kinds of selections you will find on this page every day. [...] An away win prediction is a tip that the visiting team will win the match away from their home ground. Away wins occur in roughly 28 to 30 percent of professional football matches, making them less frequent than home wins but offering stronger value when the statistical case is clear. GoalVertex publishes free away win tips every day based on away form, squad quality, H2H records at the venue, and live market data.
